title: Bhakti-Sufi Traditions: Changes in Religious Beliefs and Devotional Texts (c. eighth to eighteenth century)

topics.title: A Mosaic of Religious Beliefs and Practices

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how local deities and goddess cults were integrated into the Puranic framework.
Describe the meaning of 'great' and 'little' traditions as used by Robert Redfield.
Distinguish Tantric, Vedic and Puranic practices and the tensions between them.

topics.title: Poems of Prayer: the Alvars and Nayanars of Tamil Nadu

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the Alvars and Nayanars and the compilations of their compositions.
Analyse the attitudes of Tamil bhaktas towards caste and the place of women devotees.
Explain why the Chola rulers patronised the Nayanar and Alvar traditions.

topics.title: The Virashaiva Tradition and Religious Ferment in North India

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the beliefs and practices of the Virashaivas or Lingayats led by Basavanna.
Explain the religious situation of north India, including the Naths, Jogis and Siddhas.

topics.title: New Strands in the Fabric: Islamic Traditions

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the category of zimmi and the flexible policies of rulers towards their subjects.
Describe how the universal features of Islam blended with local traditions.
Interpret the terms used in Sanskrit texts for migrant communities.

topics.title: The Growth of Sufism and the Chishtis in the Subcontinent

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the khanqah, silsila and the difference between ba-shari'a and be-shari'a sufis.
Explain Chishti practices such as ziyarat, sama' and the use of local languages.
Analyse the relationship between the Chishti sufis and the state.

topics.title: New Devotional Paths: Kabir, Baba Guru Nanak and Mirabai

concepts.learning_objective: Describe Kabir's ideas, the compilations of his verses and debates about his life.
Explain the teachings of Baba Guru Nanak and how his message was preserved.
Describe Mirabai's life and legacy as reconstructed from her bhajans.
Distinguish the genres of sufi texts such as malfuzat, maktubat and tazkiras.
Evaluate the challenges historians face in using sources on religious traditions.
